SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REG.
File No. D 4552
SECTION 2 / Station p 3, 9
Date March 5, 1933

Subject (in full) Enquiry from Canadian Pacific Company re: D. Lichinsky

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名] 21.

With reference to the letter dated February 24, 1933
from the local office of the Canadian Pacific Railway Company
on the subject of one Dave Lichinsky, enquiries show that this
individual is at present residing at House No 18, Lane 50, Ward
Road.

Dave Lichinsky is a Russian Jew, 61 years of age, native
of Mostovoe (Herson Province, South Russia), widower, merchant by
occupation. He arrived in Shanghai from Odessa in 1905. He was
the proprietor of the "Criterion House" Hotel at No 11 Seward
Road for some time during the Great War (1914-18). At present
he is engaged in commercial pursuits on a small scale as a commis-
sion agent.

Lichinsky, during the course of an interview, stated
that about two years ago he received a letter from his brother
A. Lichinsky in Calgary, Alta., to which he replied. Since that
time, however, he has not heard from his brother.

Another brother and a relation of his are now in the
U.S.S.R., but he has not heard from them since 1928.

[签名] G. Prokofiev
D.S.

9 1933

as indicated. Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告

上海公共租界
刑事与特别股登记处
档案号 D 4552
第 2 科 / 巡捕房 p 3, 9
日期 1933 年 3 月 5 日

主题（全称） 加拿大太平洋公司关于 D. Lichinsky 的查询

由 D.S. Prokofiev 制作 转交人 [签名] 21。

兹提及加拿大太平洋铁路公司上海办事处于 1933 年 2 月 24 日就一名名为 Dave Lichinsky 的人士去信一事，经查询，此人目前居住在华德路 50 弄 18 号。

Dave Lichinsky 系俄罗斯犹太人，61 岁，原籍南俄罗斯赫尔松省莫斯托沃耶 (Mostovoe)，鳏夫，职业为商人。他于 1905 年从敖德萨抵达上海。在第一次世界大战（1914-18 年）期间，他曾一度担任西华德路 11 号“Criterion House”旅馆的业主。目前，他作为一名佣金代理人，从事小规模商业活动。

Lichinsky 在接受问询时表示，大约两年前，他收到其兄弟 A. Lichinsky 从阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里寄来的一封信，并予以回复。然而，自那以后，他便未再收到其兄弟的音讯。

他的另一位兄弟及一名亲属目前在苏联境内，但自 1928 年以来，他便未与他们有过联系。

[签名] G. Prokofiev
副巡官 (D.S.)

635 8th Ave. West,
Calgary, Alberta,
February 1, 1933.

Canadian Pacific Office,
Union Building,
4 The Bund,
Shanghai, China.

Dear Sirs,

I have a brother, Dave Lichinsky, whom I have not heard from
for eight years and am trying to get in touch with him. The last I
heard from him was when he owned the Criterion House, 11 Seward Road,
Shanghai.

I would certainly appreciate it if you could give me some in-
formation concerning him. Also may I trouble you to forward the enclosed
letter to some Jewish information bureau that might be able to give me some
information.

I hope this is not troubling you too much and thank you for your
kindness.

Yours sincerely,

A. Litchinsky (Sgd)

阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里市
西第八大道 635 号，
1933 年 2 月 1 日。

加拿大太平洋公司办事处，
联合大楼，
中国上海外滩 4 号。

敬启者：

我有一位兄弟，Dave Lichinsky，我已八年未闻其音讯，现正试图与他取得联系。我最后一次得知他的消息时，他拥有位于上海西华德路 11 号的 Criterion House 旅馆。

如蒙赐告有关他的任何信息，我将不胜感激。另外，能否麻烦您将随信附上的信件转交给某个犹太信息咨询机构，该机构或许能向我提供一些信息。

希望此举未给您带来过多困扰，并感谢您的好意。

此致
敬礼，

A. Litchinsky (签名)
